purpose: Record materially different research variants so multiple-testing adjustments use an honest trial count rather than the final published winner only.

valuation_curve_grid.definition: 6 curve slopes x 4 extreme thresholds in scripts/retrospective_core.py
valuation_curve_grid.return_series: each variant's exposure-matched timing residual, not total strategy return

valuation_calibration_family.definition: fixed reference, fixed reference with yield lag, rolling 36m equal lenses, expanding equal lenses
valuation_calibration_family.reason: different eligible windows; reported separately rather than pooled into a false common matrix

trend_challenger.definition: pre-registered SMA10 minus 20 percentage point policy

mahalanobis_valuation_challenger.definition: covariance-aware valuation-composite challenger proposed for research; not implemented or eligible for live use until frozen, backtested on a common window, and subjected to the same evidence gate

multiasset_parameter_perturbations.reason: different asset universe and research objective

metal_factor_ablations.definition: one-factor-at-a-time removals across four Gold and three Silver factors

null_families.circular_shift: all non-zero rotations of the exact observed target-weight path
null_families.ar1_surrogate_signal: Gaussian AR(1) valuation-composite surrogates calibrated to the observed composite's mean, variance and lag-1 persistence and run through the same live curve, returns and costs

lineage_policy: Publication versions and bug fixes are not automatically counted as independent statistical trials. A version enters the trial count only when it represents a materially different strategy hypothesis evaluated against outcomes.
warning: Counts across different samples/objectives are not blindly pooled into one Deflated Sharpe calculation. The robust evaluator uses the exact 24-member common-sample valuation-curve family for DSR/PBO and displays the broader registry as a governance counter. Any implemented Mahalanobis challenger that becomes comparable must increase the relevant candidate-family burden before promotion review.
